paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama4 Scout (top) and Llama4 Maverick (bottom) on 5-digit multiplication.
model_annotation:
The plot illustrates the relationship between initial confidence and various accuracy measures, including final accuracy, change in accuracy, and initial accuracy. 
The x-axis is labeled "Initial Confidence" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.95 to 0.99, with a tick label interval of 0.01. 
The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" with a linear scale, spanning from 0.0 to 1.0, with a tick label interval of 0.2. 
The plot contains three lines: "Final Acc" represented by a solid blue line with diamond markers, starting at approximately 0.89 at an initial confidence of 0.95 and ending at around 0.86 at 0.99, with a peak of about 0.87 at 0.98; "Δ Acc" represented by a dashed orange line with diamond markers, beginning at roughly 0.89 at 0.95 and decreasing to approximately 0.72 at 0.99; and "Initial Acc" represented by a dashed green line with square markers, starting at around 0.0 at 0.95 and increasing to about 0.12 at 0.99. 
The "Final Acc" line remains relatively stable, with a slight peak at an initial confidence of 0.98. The "Δ Acc" line exhibits a declining trend, while the "Initial Acc" line shows a gradual increase across the x-axis.
